tool_input.description: Verify test fails without the fix, then restore

result:
0 failures — the four warnings are pre-existing (missing test files for unrelated controllers).

The bug was a single dropped line in the serializer, not anything in the model, schema, or pages. `PostResource.toArray()` in `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts` mapped `id`, `title`, `body`, `authorId`, `createdAt` and `author`, but never `excerpt` — even though its own `PostResourceData` interface declared `excerpt: string`, which is why the pages type-checked against a field the runtime payload never carried. Since that resource is the single serialization path for every place a post reaches the frontend, one omission emptied the excerpt on the list (`posts.index`), the post page (`posts.show`), the edit form (`posts.edit`, hence the "Excerpt is required." failure on save) and the home page at once, while leaving the column itself untouched — which is exactly why `posts.search` still matched on excerpt text, since it queries the column directly rather than going through the resource. I added `excerpt: post.excerpt as string` to `toArray()`, which restores all four surfaces with no other change. I also added `tests/PostResource.test.ts`, which seeds an author and a post with a distinctive excerpt and asserts the excerpt survives both direct resource serialization and the real `/posts` and `/posts/:id` Inertia responses; I verified all three cases fail with the fix reverted and pass with it applied. `bun run typecheck` passes, `bun test` is 5/5 green, and `bunx guren check` reports 0 failures.
